_comment: Each exception needs an advisory URL, a reason, and a review-by date. The audit check fails when an exception expires, so it cannot be forgotten.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS in picomatch extglob parsing. No patched version exists (advisory range <= 4.0.7, which is the latest release). picomatch is reached only through dev, build and test tooling (vite/vitest, eslint-config-next, next-intl's file watcher) and matches glob patterns written in this repository, never user input. It is not used while serving requests. Re-check for a fixed release at the review date; npm's suggested 'fix' is a major downgrade and is not applied.
